kate_am: Heads-up - HelixBio (HB-9) flagged INV-2026-04: looks like a prorated reserved commit for a short migration window showed up in addition to their monthly commit. Snippet below.

kate_am: Invoice excerpt:
```"INV-2026-04 | HB-9 | Reserved Commit (monthly) | $6,000.00
INV-2026-04 | HB-9-mig | Reserved Prorated (04/11 16:10-16:40) | $420.00 <-- unexpected
INV-2026-04 | HB-9 | Burst (04/11 16:15-16:25) | $95.00"```

oliver_ops: Checked metering: migration service created temp tag `hb:mig-0411` during cutover and proration job ran while tag was live, so a small prorate line was billed even though usage stayed inside the monthly commit. No extra token consumption.

osteph_billing: Proposed fix: credit the prorated line $420, waive the small burst $95 as a courtesy, and offer a 1% goodwill SLA concession on committed spend = $60. Total provisional credit = $575.

tom_fin: I approve up to $600 provisional. Create FIN ticket and request infra backfill before finalizing.

kate_am: Draft customer note: "We found a proration race during migration that generated an extra prorated line. We've applied a provisional $575 credit and will issue a corrected invoice after a backfill. ETA 24-36 hours." OK to send?

osteph_billing: Yes. FIN-7920 opened to track credit.

infra-bot: INFRA-54555 created to patch proration job and run backfill for HB-9. ETA 36h.

oliver_ops: After backfill we'll validate allocations and finalize FIN-7920. Leaving thread open until invoice issued. :white_check_mark:
